answer: Proof-carrying answers: the verifier derives n = 1 + (first 4 bytes of SHA-256 over the seed words and epoch) mod 900; for kernel, reef, bridge in E66 that gives n = 211. The answer must state the Sybil cost of n identities under its own mechanism, e.g. a join fee of 3 tokens gives 633, and a script rechecks the figure, so an invented number fails automatically and graders judge only the idea. Cheapest bypass: a formula precomputed for every n passes at zero cost, so the check filters sloppiness, not Sybils; it proves arithmetic, not insight.
